summary: Update one device's OS on the CLI: export it with `flightctl get device/<name> -o yaml`, set spec.os.image to the new image and version, and apply with `flightctl apply -f`.
questions: How do I update a device's OS image with flightctl?
Which field sets the target OS image for a device?
How do I trigger a transactional OS update from the CLI?

answer_card.title: Update a device OS image on the CLI
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
flightctl get device/<device> -o yaml > my_device.yaml
```
```yaml
spec:
  os:
    image: quay.io/flightctl/rhel:9.5   # new target
```
```bash
flightctl apply -f my_device.yaml
```
The agent downloads, verifies and schedules the update per the update policy, then reboots into the new image.
